site: HEICO ADP verification flow; modal confirmation across portals
class: Substring matching confuses negative actions with affirmative consent
symptom: After successful email-code entry, the modal interceptor clicked Disagree twice and returned ADP to sign-in, ending in a validation-loop handoff.
root_cause: The selector :has-text('Agree') also matches Disagree and selected the first matching button.
why_tests_missed: The modal test contained only an affirmative I Agree action, with no preceding negative alternative.
fix: Match the complete accessible button name against the existing affirmative/close vocabulary using anchored, case-insensitive expressions. Keep entry-dialog and attestation guards.
prevention: Never use substring matches to choose between affirmative and negative actions. Test paired opposite labels in their actual order.
